```{r Orders & labels}
# --- Orders & labels --------------------------------------------------------
effect_order<- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")
measure_order <- c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")
mode_order <- c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")
contrast_order <- c("c1", "c2")
```


```{r Create correlation table cor_behav}
# --- Flags & formatters -----------------------------------------------------
cor_study2 <- cor_study2 %>%
  mutate(bold = (rho_lower > 0 & rho_upper > 0) | (rho_lower < 0 & rho_upper < 0))

fmt_mean <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt_ci <- function(lo, hi) sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi)

contrast_label <- function(mode, contrast) {
  switch(mode,
    "InDiCo"  = if (contrast == "c1") "session 1" else "session 2",
    "PoTeC"   = if (contrast == "c1") "In"        else "Out",
    "OneStop" = if (contrast == "c1") "repeated"  else "normal",
    "GECO-NL" = if (contrast == "c1") "L1"        else "L2",
    "GECO-ZH" = if (contrast == "c1") "L1"        else "L2",
    "HKC"     = if (contrast == "c1") "Paragraph" else "Sentence",
    contrast
  )
}

# return mean or CI; bold both if both CI bounds share sign
get_cell <- function(mode, contrast, effect, measure, part = c("mean","ci")) {
  part <- match.arg(part)
  row <- cor_study2 %>%
    filter(mode == !!mode, Contrast == !!contrast,
           effect == !!effect, measures == !!measure)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return("--")
  mean_txt <- fmt_mean(row$rho_mean)
  ci_txt   <- fmt_ci(row$rho_lower, row$rho_upper)
  if (row$bold) {
    mean_txt <- paste0("\\textbf{", mean_txt, "}")
    ci_txt   <- paste0("\\textbf{", ci_txt, "}")
  }
  if (part == "mean") mean_txt else ci_txt
}

# --- Build LaTeX lines ------------------------------------------------------
row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"  # extra height

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.2pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{@{}>{\\centering\\arraybackslash}m{0.9cm}@{}c ccccccccc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",

  # Header row 1
  paste0(
    "\\multicolumn{2}{>{\\centering\\arraybackslash}m{2.6cm}}",
    "{\\large\\textbf{Correlation (\\boldmath$\\hat{\\rho}$) b/w}} & ",
    "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Word Length Spillover}} & ",
    "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Lexical Frequency Spillover}} & ",
    "\\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Surprisal Spillover}} \\\\"
  ),

  "\\cmidrule(lr){3-5}\\cmidrule(lr){6-8}\\cmidrule(lr){9-11}",

  # Header row 2
  paste0(
    "\\multicolumn{2}{c}{} & ",
    "\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.} & ",
    "\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.} & ",
    "\\textbf{Skip Rate} & \\textbf{Regr. Rate} & \\textbf{Local Eff.} \\\\"
  ),

  "\\midrule",
  "\\rowcolors{3}{gray!08}{white}"
)

# Data rows
for (mode in mode_order) {
  for (j in seq_along(contrast_order)) {
    # print(j)
    contrast <- contrast_order[j]
    label <- contrast_label(mode, contrast)

    # row 1 (means)
    row1 <- c()
    if (j == 1) {
      row1 <- c(row1, paste0("\\multirow{4}{*}{\\centering\\rotatebox[origin=c]{90}{\\textbf{", mode, "}}}"))
    } else {
      row1 <- c(row1, "")
    }
    row1 <- c(row1, paste0("\\multirow{2}{*}{\\textbf{", label, "}}"))
    first <- TRUE
    for (eff in effect_order) {
      for (meas in measure_order) {
        v <- get_cell(mode, contrast, eff, meas, "mean")
        if (first) { v <- paste0(row_strut, " ", v); first <- FALSE }
        row1 <- c(row1, v)
      }
    }
    lines <- c(lines, paste(row1, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")

    # row 2 (CI)
    row2 <- c("", "")
    first2 <- TRUE
    for (eff in effect_order) {
      for (meas in measure_order) {
        v2 <- get_cell(mode, contrast, eff, meas, "ci")
        if (first2) { v2 <- paste0(row_strut, " ", v2); first2 <- FALSE }
        row2 <- c(row2, v2)
      }
    }
    lines <- c(lines, paste(row2, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
    if (j < length(contrast_order)) {
      print("add space")
  lines <- c(lines, "\\addlinespace[6pt]")
}
  }
  lines <- c(lines, " \\midrule")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end scriptsize",
"\\caption{Posterior mean correlations and 95\\% credible intervals between spillover effects and reading pattern measures (skip rate, regression rate, and local effects). Values in bold indicate correlations whose 95\\% credible intervals exclude zero.}",
  "\\label{tab:cor_behav_meas}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# --- Write LaTeX to file ----------------------------------------------------
writeLines(lines, "../results/latex/cor_behav_meas.tex")
```

```{r Read csv for pop effect, warning=FALSE}
pred_order  <- c("Word Len.","Lex. Freq.","Surprisal")
loc_order   <- c("Local","Spillover")

fmt <- function(m, lo, up) {
  same_sign <- (lo > 0 & up > 0) | (lo < 0 & up < 0)
  ifelse(
    same_sign,
    sprintf("\\sigestci{%.2f}{%.2f}{%.2f}", m, lo, up),
    sprintf("\\nonsigestci{%.2f}{%.2f}{%.2f}", m, lo, up)
  )
}
```

```{r Create table for pop effect}
get_cell_fixed <- function(mode, pred, loc){ 
  sub <- fixtab %>% 
    filter(mode == !!mode, predictor == !!pred, location == !!loc) 
  sub$cell[1] }

# print(get_cell_fixed("PoTeC", "Lex. Freq.", "Local"))
# print(get_cell_fixed("InDiCo", "Word Len.", "Spillover"))

top_header_cells <- vapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  sprintf("\\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{%s}}", p)
}, character(1))
# print(top_header_cells)
sub_header_cells <- rep(loc_order, times = length(pred_order))
# print(sub_header_cells)

header_row1 <- paste(
  "\\multirow{2}{*}{\\shortstack[c]{\\textbf{Pop. Effect}\\\\\\textbf{(log-ms)}}} &",
  paste(top_header_cells, collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)

# Row 2: (first cell omitted; occupied by the multirow)
header_row2 <- paste(
  "&",
  paste(sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", sub_header_cells), collapse = " & "),
  "\\\\"
)



# cmidrule ranges for each predictor group (start at column 2 because col 1 = Mode)
cmid_rules <- {
  starts <- 2 + 2 * (0:(length(pred_order)-1))
  ends   <- starts + 1
  paste0("\\cmidrule(lr){", starts, "-", ends, "}", collapse = "")
}

# --- Build LaTeX lines ---
row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.5pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  # 1 column for Mode + 6 data columns (3 predictors × 2 locations)
  "\\begin{tabular}{@{}lcccccc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  header_row1,
  cmid_rules,
  header_row2,
  "\\midrule"
)

# --- Data rows (modes) ---
col_keys <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pred_order, function(p) {
  data.frame(predictor = p, location = loc_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
# col_keys

for (mode in mode_order) {
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(col_keys)), function(i) {
    get_cell_fixed(mode, col_keys$predictor[i], col_keys$location[i])
  }, character(1))
  cells[1] <- paste0(row_strut, " ", cells[1])  # slight height
  lines <- c(lines, paste(c(mode, cells), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end normalsize",
  "\\caption{Posterior mean and 95\\% credible intervals for the local and spillover fixed effects of word length, lexical frequency, and surprisal across datasets. Effects are shown in log space (natural logarithms).}",
  "\\label{tab:pop_effects}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# --- Write & print ---
out_path <- "../results/latex/pop_eff.tex"
dir.create(dirname(out_path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(lines, out_path)
message("Wrote: ", out_path)

# cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r}
rb <- read_csv("../results/stats/spillover_measurement_reliability.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  # filter(location == "spillover") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cor_len, cor_freq, cor_surp),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "eff_size"
  ) %>%
  mutate(predictor = recode(predictor,
                            cor_len  = "Word Len.",
                            cor_freq = "Lex. Freq.",
                            cor_surp = "Surprisal")) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = c("local", "spillover"), labels = c("Local", "Spillover")),
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = c("Word Len.", "Lex. Freq.", "Surprisal")),
         mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC"))
         ) %>%
  group_by(location, mode, predictor) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_eff = mean(eff_size),
    # lower    = quantile(eff_size, 0.025),
    # upper    = quantile(eff_size, 0.975),
    lower = hdi(eff_size, credMass = 0.95)[1],
    upper = hdi(eff_size, credMass = 0.95)[2],
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

View(rb)
```

```{r Psychometric_profile_table}
m <- read_rds("../models/psycho-profile/indico_profile_log_rt_full_int_full_raneff_6000iter_bayes.rds")

# 1) Extract fixed effects and retain the required statistics
f <- brms::fixef(
  m,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.055, 0.945, 0.975)
)

f_df <- data.frame(
  term     = rownames(f),
  Estimate = f[, "Estimate"],
  l89      = f[, "Q5.5"],
  u89      = f[, "Q94.5"],
  l95      = f[, "Q2.5"],
  u95      = f[, "Q97.5"],
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# 2) Format estimates using the LaTeX significance macros
fmt <- function(m, l89, u89, l95, u95) {
  excludes_zero_89 <- (l89 > 0 & u89 > 0) | (l89 < 0 & u89 < 0)
  excludes_zero_95 <- (l95 > 0 & u95 > 0) | (l95 < 0 & u95 < 0)

  cell <- if (excludes_zero_95) {
    sprintf(
      "\\sigestci{%.3f}{%.3f}{%.3f}",
      m, l95, u95
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "\\nonsigestci{%.3f}{%.3f}{%.3f}",
      m, l95, u95
    )
  }

  # if (excludes_zero_89) {
  #   cell <- paste0("\\textbf{", cell, "}")
  # }

  if (excludes_zero_89) {
    cell <- paste0(cell, "\\textsuperscript{\\(\\diamond\\)}")
  }

  cell
}

# 3) Fetch an interaction regardless of term order: a:b or b:a
get_cell_interaction <- function(a, b) {
  possible_terms <- c(
    paste0(a, ":", b),
    paste0(b, ":", a)
  )

  row <- f_df[
    f_df$term %in% possible_terms,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(row) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Missing or duplicate interaction term: ",
      paste0(a, ":", b)
    )
  }

  fmt(row$Estimate, row$l89, row$u89, row$l95, row$u95)
}

# 4) Table labels
row_labels <- c(
  "Current Word Len.",
  "Current Lex. Freq.",
  "Current Surprisal",
  "Previous Word Len.",
  "Previous Lex. Freq.",
  "Previous Surprisal"
)

col_headers <- c(
  "Interaction b/w",
  "Reading Fluency",
  "Working Memory",
  "Cognitive Control"
)

# 5) Interactions in the required column order:
#    Reading Fluency, Working Memory, Cognitive Control
row_terms <- list(
  list(
    c("len", "reading"),
    c("len", "memory"),
    c("len", "cogcontr")
  ),
  list(
    c("freq", "reading"),
    c("freq", "memory"),
    c("freq", "cogcontr")
  ),
  list(
    c("surp", "reading"),
    c("surp", "memory"),
    c("surp", "cogcontr")
  ),
  list(
    c("prev_len", "reading"),
    c("prev_len", "memory"),
    c("prev_len", "cogcontr")
  ),
  list(
    c("prev_freq", "reading"),
    c("prev_freq", "memory"),
    c("prev_freq", "cogcontr")
  ),
  list(
    c("prev_surp", "reading"),
    c("prev_surp", "memory"),
    c("prev_surp", "cogcontr")
  )
)

# 6) Build the LaTeX table
lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{6pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  "\\begin{tabular}{lccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  paste0(
    "\\textbf{",
    paste(col_headers, collapse = "} & \\textbf{"),
    "} \\\\"
  ),
  "\\midrule"
)

for (i in seq_along(row_labels)) {
  cells <- vapply(
    row_terms[[i]],
    function(pair) {
      get_cell_interaction(pair[1], pair[2])
    },
    character(1)
  )

  lines <- c(
    lines,
    paste0(
      paste(c(row_labels[i], cells), collapse = " & "),
      " \\\\"
    )
  )

  # Visually separate current-word and previous-word interactions
  if (i == 3) {
    lines <- c(lines, "\\midrule")
  }
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end scriptsize",
  "\\caption{Posterior means and credible intervals for interaction effects between cognitive abilities and current-word and spillover predictors, including word length, lexical frequency, and surprisal. Estimates are reported on the log reading-time scale (natural
logarithms). Boldface indicates estimates whose 95\\% credible intervals exclude zero; a superscript diamond (\\(\\diamond\\)) indicates estimates whose 89\\% credible intervals exclude zero.}",
  "\\label{tab:psych_word_interactions}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# 7) Write to file and print to console

dir.create(

  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
```

```{r archive 1}
fmt_two_line <- function(m, lo, up, eps = 0) {
  # optional: treat tiny values as zero to avoid -0.00 and near-zero sign flips
  if (eps > 0) {
    z <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) < eps, 0, x)
    m  <- z(m); lo <- z(lo); up <- z(up)
  }
  same_sign <- (lo > 0 & up > 0) | (lo < 0 & up < 0)

  mean_norm <- sprintf("$%.2f$", m)
  ci_norm   <- sprintf("$[%.2f,\\,%.2f]$", lo, up)

  mean_bold <- paste0("{\\boldmath$", sprintf("%.2f", m), "$}")
  ci_bold   <- paste0("{\\boldmath$[", sprintf("%.2f", lo), ",\\,", sprintf("%.2f", up), "]$}")

  cell_norm <- paste0("\\shortstack[c]{", mean_norm, " \\\\ ", ci_norm, "}")
  cell_bold <- paste0("\\shortstack[c]{", mean_bold, " \\\\ ", ci_bold, "}")

  ifelse(same_sign, cell_bold, cell_norm)
}

rb_tab <- rb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell = fmt_two_line(mean_eff, lower, upper)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(predictor, mode, cell) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = mode, values_from = cell)

# --- Header: bold each line of the mode names inside \shortstack ------------
mk_head <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    parts <- strsplit(s, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] <- paste0("\\textbf{", parts[1], "}")
    paste0("\\shortstack[c]{", paste(parts, collapse = " \\\\ "), "}")
  }, character(1))
}

# Column (mode) order from the pivoted table (everything except first col 'predictor')
mode_order <- names(rb_tab)[names(rb_tab) != "predictor"]

row_strut <- "\\rule{0pt}{2.2ex}"
colspec   <- paste0("@{}l", paste(rep("c", length(mode_order)), collapse = ""), "@{}")

# Header row: explicit empty top-left cell + bold-per-line shortstacks
header_line <- paste(
  c("\\multicolumn{1}{c}{}", mk_head(mode_order)),
  collapse = " & "
)

# --- LaTeX builder ----------------------------------------------------------
lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]",
  "\\centering",
  "{\\scriptsize",
  "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2.5pt}",
  "\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.22}",
  "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{%",
  paste0("\\begin{tabular}{", colspec, "}"),
  "\\toprule",
  paste0(header_line, " \\\\"),
  "\\midrule"
)

for (r in seq_len(nrow(rb_tab))) {
  pred_lab <- paste0("\\textbf{", as.character(rb_tab$predictor[r]), "}")
  cells    <- as.character(unlist(rb_tab[r, mode_order], use.names = FALSE))
  if (length(cells) > 0) cells[1] <- paste0(row_strut, " ", cells[1])  # slight row height on first cell
  lines <- c(lines, paste(c(pred_lab, cells), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
}

lines <- c(
  lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "}% end resizebox",
  "}% end scriptsize",
  "\\caption{Cross-context spillover measurement reliability (95\\% credible intervals) by predictor and mode.}",
  "\\label{tab:spillover_reliability}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

out_path <- "../results/latex/overall_spillover_reliability.tex"
dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(lines, out_path)
cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```
